B: Magnetic field at the star's surface
B_0: Magnetic field of the core before the collapse
M_odot: Mass of the Sun, the solar mass
P: Spin period: the time for one turn
P_0: Spin period of the core before the collapse
R_0: Radius of the core before the collapse
dot P: Rate at which the spin period grows
v: Speed of a point on the equator
